CNfzT1Ha63GTeJ99N9ii73HzCwyLUTXj3mbiwCyv.title: BNICE
CNfzT1Ha63GTeJ99N9ii73HzCwyLUTXj3mbiwCyv.tagline: A community token commemorating October 17, 2026, when a shop worker at Micromania in Nice stood his ground for his neighborhood.
story: On October 17, 2026, protests over the cost of living in central Nice turned to unrest, and shops along the avenue were damaged. A shop worker at the Micromania store stayed in his doorway to protect the store and the street around it, and the moment moved people far beyond Nice.
BNICE was launched by fans to remember it: a thank-you to everyone who stands up for the small businesses and the people that make a neighborhood.

4Et4VBfZEh1bVXoeodEKKiiknd44eBUTP2XQoRRE.tagline: A community token celebrating Bitcoin adoption at the counter: Steak 'n Shake became one of the first big US restaurant chains to accept Bitcoin.
story: For years, paying for everyday things with Bitcoin felt like a someday idea. Then a burger chain with hundreds of restaurants started accepting it at the counter, and paying with Bitcoin for a burger and a shake became an everyday thing.
STEAKN was launched by fans during PunchCard's first Open Doors as an ode to that moment, and to every business that makes crypto something people can actually use.
